hm. ok i got installed and went to run a test and failed D: (instantmesh) siah@busiah ~/creative/reactjit/deps/InstantMesh $ python run.py configs/instant-mesh-large.yaml home/siah/creative/reactjit/deps/InstantMesh/examples/blue_cat.png --output_path outputs --export_texmap
2026-06-19 09:26:26.996157307 [W:onnxruntime:Default, device_discovery.cc:164 DiscoverDevicesForPlatform] GPU device discovery failed: device_discovery.cc:89 ReadFileContents Failed to open file: "/sys/class/drm/card5/device/vendor"
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/siah/creative/reactjit/deps/InstantMesh/run.py", line 8, in <module>
    from pytorch_lightning import seed_everything
  File "/home/siah/miniconda3/envs/instantmesh/lib/python3.10/site-packages/pytorch_lightning/__init__.py", line 25, in <module>
    from lightning_fabric.utilities.seed import seed_everything  # noqa: E402
  File "/home/siah/miniconda3/envs/instantmesh/lib/python3.10/site-packages/lightning_fabric/__init__.py", line 40, in <module>
    __import__("pkg_resources").declare_namespace(__name__)
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pkg_resources'
resolution: InstantMesh smoke test hit 'No module named pkg_resources': pytorch-lightning 2.1.2/lightning_fabric calls pkg_resources.declare_namespace but setuptools>=81 removed pkg_resources. Gave the user the immediate fix (pip install 'setuptools<81') and pinned it in setup-instantmesh.sh. Also flagged a path typo in their command (missing leading / — use relative examples/blue_cat.png from the repo dir). onnxruntime DRM warning is harmless. Committed.
